title: Triple Difference Designs with Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
abstract: arXiv:2502.19620v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Triple difference designs have become increasingly popular in empirical economics. The advantage of a triple difference design is that, within a treatment group, it allows another subgroup of the population -- potentially less impacted by the treatment -- to serve as a comparison for the subgroup of interest. While literature on difference-in-differences has discussed heterogeneity in treatment effects between treated and control groups or over time, relatively little attention has been given to triple difference designs and the implications of heterogeneity in treatment effects in this setting. In this paper, I show that the parameter identified under common triple difference assumptions does not allow for causal interpretation of differences between subgroups when subgroups may differ in their underlying (unobserved) treatment effects. translated_title: 异质性处理效应下的三重差分设计
translated_abstract: 三重差分设计在实证经济学中日益流行。三重差分设计的优势在于，在处理组内部，它允许另一个人群子群体——可能受处理影响较小的群体——作为所关注子群体的比较对象。尽管关于双重差分的文献已讨论了处理组与对照组之间或随时间变化的处理效应异质性，但针对三重差分设计以及在此背景下处理效应异质性所带来影响的研究相对较少。本文表明，当子群体在其潜在的（未观测到的）处理效应上可能存在差异时，在常见三重差分假设下识别出的参数无法对子群体之间的差异提供因果解释。作者提出了一个新的关注参数，即受控的平均处理效应差异。
tldr: 本文指出，当子群体存在未观测的处理效应异质性时，传统三重差分假设下识别的参数无法对子群体间差异进行因果解释，并提出了受控平均处理效应差异这一新的关注参数。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that under common triple difference assumptions, the identified parameter lacks causal interpretation for subgroup differences when subgroups have heterogeneous unobserved treatment effects, and proposes the controlled difference in average treatment effects as a new estimand.
